Description: Susceptible individuals become infected through contact with infectious living individuals or infectious deceased individuals and move to the non-symptomatic exposed compartment.
Non-symptomatic infected individuals progress to become symptomatic and infectious.
Symptomatic infectious individuals recover from the disease and gain immunity.
Symptomatic infectious individuals die from the disease and become infectious deceased.

Name: cD
Description: contact rate with infectious dead bodies

Name: ω
Description: rate at which infected individuals becoming infectious

Name: R0
Description: The reproduction number or eradication threshold, representing the average number of susceptible people that one infected individual will infect.
